purpose: Independently measure original-source coverage even though separate chirplet control failed; never re-enable failed compensated-source analysis
samples: All48unchanged frozen native12000frame F3 stereo tiles and original local fits. No new fitting, window/line selection, filtering, resampling, gain or audio export
models: All original fitted lines versus original eligible-only lines. Both retain same original DC; oscillator basis from original independent f/q and cos/sin. Unsuccessful window has no eligible lines, remains included. Model-source ratio is NOT explained power, because interference can be negative
power_identity: Periodic-Hann native source X, model Y and R=X-Y. Save source/model/residual and signed2Re(YconjR) in all seven physical bands and both channels. Identity source=model+residual+interference must hold; no residual classified as physical noise or zeroed negative budget
controls: Exact known separated band tones; missing high tone; model1.5times source destructive interference and model power/source>1 counterexample. Native known Parseval and independent complex-source/scalar band sums audit
report: Per-tile source band power fractions, model/source and residual/source plus signed cross/source. Aggregate only raw summed powers over original equal-length windows, preserving per-window values, fit/guide failures and eligible counts. Also total line frequency range. No audio/source identity inferred from ratios
limits: F3 cabin only, all passages previously inspected, no measured RPM/load/AV calibration, physical combustion/road/wind separation or common engine phase. Earlier phase-extractor gates remain. Failed accel_wideband_v1 compensation gate and exact sources retained; no source chirplet transform run after failure
